_about: What LEGO Pick a Brick actually sells, learned from list uploads (elementId,quantity). Element IDs are chosen newest-first from Rebrickable's elements, except: IDs inside an avoid range are skipped when the part/colour has another ID; `use_instead` swaps an ID Pick a Brick rejected for one it accepted; `unavailable` IDs are left out of pick_a_brick.csv (buy those on BrickLink). Verified by uploading the VHS Cassette list on 2026-09-30.
_avoid_ranges: Every element tested from this block (11 White parts, 2026-09) was unavailable on Pick a Brick while an older ID for the same part/colour was available.
